title: The Feasibility of a Virtual/Home-based OA Treatment Program in Older Adults With OA and Multimorbidity
official: The Feasibility of a Virtual/Home-based OA Treatment Program in Older Adults With OA and Multimorbidity
summary:
Knee Osteoarthritis is one of the most common causes of chronic joint pain. Although clinical guidelines recommend weight loss and regular physical activity as first line treatments this can be difficult for patients to do. This study aims to better understand what makes it harder or easier for patients to participate in weight management or exercise programs and to design a weight and exercise program specifically tailored to older adults managing chronic health issues.

Based on input from patients and providers we will design and pilot a virtual exercise and weight management program to help patients with knee osteoarthritis in their home. Participants will be asked to fill out questionnaires about their knee pain and have phone or video check-ins with the study team to monitor progress.

interventions.name: Home-based exercise and weight management program

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Clinician-diagnosed osteoarthritis of the knee
* Obesity (BMI \>30)
* Cardiovascular disease and/or diabetes mellitus
* English speaking

Exclusion Criteria:

* Inflammatory arthritis
* Antecedent acute trauma
* Consistent use of a wheelchair
* Moderate to severe dementia
